why: Stops asking capture to keep its raw PNGs, which is what the entire comparison is computed from -- analyseFrames reads <dir>/frames/ and would find nothing. Pinned because it genuinely survived: capture-runner is the seam every orchestrator test replaces with a fake, so dropping this flag left all 100 other tests green until the module got a test of its own.
killedBy: runCaptureAtRef ALWAYS asks capture to retain its frames
